body.name: T_h
body.def: Fix one rational triangulation \(\mathcal T_0\) conforming to \(B\), all cell boundaries, and all density and boundary-weight knots. Recursively form \(\mathcal T_{k+1}\) by joining the three rational edge midpoints of every triangle of \(\mathcal T_k\), and write \(\mathcal T_h=\mathcal T_k\) when \(h=\max_{T\in\mathcal T_k}\operatorname{diam}(T)\).
